summary: GrowInLove is a relationship-focused web app built for the Internet Computer (Motoko canister backend + React frontend). Authenticated users (via Internet Identity) create a profile, pair with a partner using a 6-digit code, complete daily ritual prompts (with text/emoji and optional photo uploads), review ritual history (Home + Memories scrapbook), take a Love Languages quiz with partner synchronization, and view an Insights dashboard (streak/harmony/badges UI). The Activities tab provides client-side engagement features like a weighted Love Wheel and streak-gated activity packs (with admin override).

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication (login/logout + identity restore)
existing_features.description: Provides a React context for Internet Identity authentication, restores a previously authenticated identity on app load, exposes login/logout actions, and tracks detailed status flags (initializing/logging-in/success/error).

existing_features.title: Identity-bound backend actor creation with access-control bootstrap
existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous actor when unauthenticated and an identity-bound actor when authenticated; on authenticated creation, calls a backend bootstrap to initialize/register access control using an env-gated admin token plus a user-provided secret extracted from the URL hash.

existing_features.title: Role-based access control (admin/user/guest) with admin role assignment
existing_features.description: Backend maintains a Principal→role mapping; supports admin detection and admin-only role assignment. Frontend queries admin status for gated/override UI paths.

existing_features.title: User profile onboarding and editing with backend safety checks
existing_features.description: Authenticated users initialize a profile (name). Profile updates are allowed but backend prevents unauthorized changes to role/isFirstUser and disallows directly mutating partnerId outside the pairing flow.

existing_features.title: Tab-based SPA shell with Top Bar + Bottom Navigation
existing_features.description: Implements a multi-tab single-page interface (Home, Insights, Memories, Activities, Us, Love Languages) with top bar actions (theme toggle, notifications placeholder, login/logout) and content switching without a router.

existing_features.title: Light/dark theme with system default and persistent override
existing_features.description: Applies light/dark theme classes to the document root based on system preference by default, allows a user override via a UI toggle, persists preference in localStorage, and listens for OS theme changes when in system mode.

existing_features.title: Partner pairing via 6-digit code (generate/share/complete)
existing_features.description: Users generate a 6-digit pairing code, share/copy it, and connect by entering a partner’s code. Pairing is blocked until a profile exists and results in mutual partnerId linkage on both profiles.

existing_features.title: Canonical couple identity + mutual partnership enforcement
existing_features.description: Backend derives a canonical coupleId from two paired principals and requires mutual pairing to access couple-scoped data such as rituals, ritual history, and combined quiz state.

existing_features.title: Daily ritual prompt retrieval with deterministic selection and lazy prompt initialization
existing_features.description: Backend lazily initializes a fixed prompt list and selects the daily prompt deterministically by day number modulo prompt count. Frontend renders the prompt with a love-language themed hero card.

existing_features.title: Daily ritual submission (text/emoji/photo)
existing_features.description: Users submit a daily ritual response containing optional text, an emoji, and an optional uploaded photoId. Backend stores/merges responses per couple per day.

existing_features.title: Ritual completion status with canonical partner attribution + polling
existing_features.description: Backend reports ritual completion for canonical partnerA/partnerB; frontend derives caller vs partner completion and polls regularly to show “waiting” and “both completed” states.

existing_features.title: Ritual completion celebration animation overlay
existing_features.description: Shows a decorative floating-hearts overlay when both partners complete a ritual; heart positions are memoized to avoid regenerating random positions on each render.

existing_features.title: Ritual history retrieval and viewing (Home modal + Memories scrapbook)
existing_features.description: Fetches reverse-chronological ritual history with a configurable limit; frontend defensively sorts newest-first and provides both a Home list with modal drill-in and a Memories page with expand/collapse plus progressive “Load More” behavior.

existing_features.title: Shared photo storage (upload/get/list/delete) with partner/admin access rules
existing_features.description: Backend stores uploaded image blobs with owner metadata and enforces access rules (owner, mutual partner, or admin). Frontend supports photo selection/preview, upload, and inline rendering via direct blob URLs.

existing_features.title: Love Languages quiz (7 questions) with persistence, sharing, and reset/retake
existing_features.description: Client implements a multi-step quiz, computes rankings, saves results to backend, reloads saved results, supports retake with confirmation and backend reset, and supports sharing results via Web Share API or clipboard.

existing_features.title: Partner quiz synchronization and combined quiz state
existing_features.description: Backend exposes combined quiz completion/results for a couple and partner quiz state. Frontend polls for updates and shows synced/waiting banners plus an error fallback with manual retry refetch.

existing_features.title: Insights dashboard UI wired to backend insights + badge milestone endpoints
existing_features.description: Renders a relationship insights dashboard (streak, harmony, 7‑day history visuals, milestone badges) with admin override for access gating, celebration overlay on detected new badge unlocks, and a guarded “not enough data yet” trend display.

existing_features.title: Harmony UI utilities and deep-link navigation to the harmony section
existing_features.description: Provides helpers for consistent harmony percent display and trend labeling; supports navigation from Home/Us to the Insights harmony section using a sessionStorage flag and scrollIntoView behavior.

existing_features.title: Activities hub (Love Wheel + streak-gated activity packs + placeholders)
existing_features.description: Client-side engagement tab featuring a weighted spin wheel (biased by shared top love languages when both quizzes are complete) with daily localStorage persistence, streak-gated love-language activity packs (admin unlock override), plus placeholder UI for challenges and reward progress.

existing_features.title: Reusable loading/empty/error UI components
existing_features.description: Shared UI primitives for consistent loading, empty, and error states (including optional retry and expandable technical details) for data-driven screens.

existing_features.title: Caffeine blob-storage maintenance endpoints (gateway update, dead blob pruning, cashier refill)
existing_features.description: Operational endpoints to refill a cashier canister with cycles, update gateway principals, list dead blobs, and confirm pruning with forced GC triggering; used for storage maintenance on the Internet Computer.

existing_features.title: Implement a single global ThemeProvider/ThemeContext that stores `theme` ('light'|'dark'|'system') and `effectiveTheme` ('light'|'dark'), and centralizes all DOM theme class application (adding/removing `light`/`dark` on `document.documentElement`) in exactly one place.

Refactor the existing theme hook API so app code can continue using a hook to access theme state, but ensure there are no DOM reads during render and no duplicate system-theme listeners; only one system preference listener is active and only when `theme === 'system'`.
Update ThemeToggle to use the ThemeContext values for rendering (including aria-label and icon state) and for toggling, eliminating icon/state desynchronization.
Ensure localStorage persistence for theme preference only happens in the explicit theme setter/toggle action (not on every render and not in effects that run repeatedly).

Make the Home → Ritual History entry dialog readable by ensuring the dialog content surface is fully opaque (optionally with a subtle backdrop blur) in both light and dark themes, without editing any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose via className overrides at the call site).

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix light/dark theme toggle: implement a single global ThemeProvider/ThemeContext with effectiveTheme, centralized DOM class application, and reactive ThemeToggle UI
Fix Home → Ritual History dialog readability: make modal sheet opaque (optionally with backdrop blur) instead of transparent; verify in light and dark mode

architectural_notes: Backend is a Motoko canister that composes cross-cutting concerns via mixins (authorization + caffeine blob-storage maintenance).

Role-based access control is Principal-keyed, with first-time/bootstrapped admin assignment gated by an environment token and a user-provided secret (passed from the frontend) and enforced in backend methods.
Couple-scoped authorization is enforced by requiring mutual pairing and deriving a canonical coupleId from sorted principal text, used to gate couple data (rituals/history/quiz state).
Frontend is a tab-based React SPA (no router), with app-level gating for unauthenticated, unprofiled, and unpaired states.

Canister IO is centralized in @tanstack/react-query hooks (queries + mutations), including targeted cache invalidation/refetch and polling for partner synchronization (ritual status, quiz state) and insights/badges refresh.
UI is built with Tailwind + shadcn/ui components and an OKLCH token-based design system; dark mode uses Tailwind class strategy (document root class).
Theme preference supports system default and persistent user override via localStorage, with system change listeners active only in system mode.
Photos are stored as blobs via backend storage types and rendered client-side via direct blob URLs (ExternalBlob.getDirectURL).
Animations and UI polish are handled via global CSS utilities with prefers-reduced-motion safeguards and dialog overlay/content styling for readability.

Theme handling should use a single app-level ThemeProvider/ThemeContext as the source of truth (theme preference + effectiveTheme), with centralized DOM class toggling and system-theme listeners only in system mode.
known_issues: Backend getInsightsData currently returns placeholder/default values (zeros/empty arrays) despite rich response types; real insights computation (streaks, harmony, trends, milestone progress) appears not implemented or not wired up.
Backend getBadgeMilestones returns default milestone progress (getDefaultMilestoneProgress) rather than persisted/computed milestoneProgress; badges/milestones may not reflect actual behavior.
_caffeineStorageUpdateGatewayPrincipals() has no authorization check in the storage mixin, allowing any caller to refresh gateway principal lists.
blob-storage Storage.getCashierPrincipal reads env var CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL (typo with triple 'F'); misconfiguration will trap at runtime.
blob-storage Storage.refillCashier uses Nat.sub(currentBalance, reservedCycles) and can trap if currentBalance < reservedCycles.
Frontend useArePromptsInitialized() is a stub that always returns true (backend prompt-init status endpoint is missing), so admin “Prompts Active” is not a real health check.
CSS animation class mismatch: components use className "animate-float-up" but global CSS defines "completion-float-up" (not "animate-float-up"), so some intended float animations may not run.
Access control bootstrap depends on CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN being set; if missing, _initializeAccessControlWithSecret traps and prevents authenticated actor creation entirely.
Pairing codes are described as expirable, but backend does not implement expiration timestamps/cleanup; codes remain valid until used/removed.
Pairing code generation uses a deterministic PRNG/seeded scheme (predictable codes), which may be acceptable for a beta but is not cryptographically secure.
